findings.quote: Dhaaga & Co. hereby announces the availability of premium bed linen solutions engineered to optimise consumer sleep outcomes through advanced textile methodologies.
findings.explanation: This is corporate jargon and hard-sell phrasing, not the warm, explanatory tone of a friend. It uses passive, technical language instead of addressing the reader as 'you' and explaining benefits simply.
findings.suggestedFix: The Monsoon Weave is back — handwoven cotton that gets softer with every wash.
findings.reviewNote: Tone is a judgement call, so a person makes the final decision. The quote spans more than one sentence, so the exact problem isn't pinned down.

intent.note: Reframes to product launch; both MUST KEEP items retained.
